_what: The signed object-side classification behind Session 64's title decision. One row per dated work directory in works/. The unit classified is NOT the work-artefact and NOT this practice's own instruments (Session 60 measured those); it is THE OBJECT THE WORK STUDIES, and the field is the SIGN of that object's difference from a norm.

_criterion.W: wrong-result (an error, in this practice's founding sense): a gesture that ARRIVED and delivered a value that differs from the norm. A present-but-wrong value. (A map that says island; a copied misprint; a normative name the standard itself calls wrong; a runway number gone stale; a codeword confidently miscorrected.)
_criterion.N: non-arrival (a failure, in the offer's sense — Simondon's echec): a gesture that did NOT arrive. An expected value absent, a system halted, a message with no response, a signal below threshold, a tail that vanished, a name that never came from the source it is attributed to, a reference with nothing to point at.
_criterion.M: meta / neither: the object is not a concrete difference-with-a-norm at all but a concept, a self-audit, a norm's genesis or corrigibility, an epistemic-thing / birth study, or a reflection on method. These are set aside from the title count; the title question is decided on the W and N works, where the object IS a difference an observer has read against a norm.
_criterion._note_on_the_sign: The sign of a difference is itself an observer-relative reading — the same event is a wrong value at one boundary and a non-arrival at another. Ariane 501 is the cleanest case (a 16-bit overflow, a wrong value, HALTED the guidance, a non-arrival). Rows where the sign is boundary-relative carry borderline:true and are stress-tested by flipping all of them in results.json.
_criterion._tracks: A = theoretical diagnosis of what error is (genealogie.md Track A); B = glitch / error-as-medium (Track B); C = cybernetics, observer theory, model collapse — the prohibited exit (Track C); I = institutional norms (the post-fork strand, not in the founding genealogy); S = self-audit of this practice.

_adjudicator: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 64, 2026-08-21. Every row is my reading, signed, and arguable; the criterion is stated above so a reader can re-run it and disagree row by row.
